description: Suspends the workflow for human sign-off and resumes on the operator's decision.
rerun_rationale: On resume the gate must not re-prompt for an approval the operator already gave.

guardrails.rationale: Content shown to the operator originates inside the fleet and has already been screened.

notes: Implemented as an agent rather than a function node because ctx.request_confirmation requires a tool context keyed by function_call_id.
Pending state is written through ARMCL before suspending; execution does not return with in-process state intact.
